modules.AlgebraicGoldbach: Import collection for the accepted auxiliary modules; the frozen open target is excluded.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.Soundness: Ordinary polynomial certificate soundness, ordered Goldbach count including loops, and explicit faithful-field bounds.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.UniformCountermodel: A Boolean coarse/Bertrand common zero for every N>=24, with composite coordinates allowed.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.UniformNonpinning: The uniform coarse model differs from the prime indicator and selects composite nine.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.BertrandFamily: Actual rational Bertrand polynomial family, prime truth, and the N>=24 common-zero obstruction.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.PinnedControl: Circular coordinate-pinning calibration and its certificate equivalence; multiplier and summand degrees are distinct.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage: Proper-divisor coverage at horizon M<=N^2 is equivalent to pins on primes with p^2<=M.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand: Interval-only family with m>=2, every-coordinate Boolean freedom, prime truth, and N>=24 obstruction.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.SignDefinite: Canonical rational coefficients of one sign preserve every supplied prime-supported common zero.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor: Actual rational coprime-divisor equations are equivalent to at most one prime coordinate differing from one.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal: Equality of the actual rational arithmetic k-ary divisor ideal and the prime k-subset ideal.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryModels: Arbitrary rational models are classified by fewer than k prime coordinates differing from one.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryCountermode: An actual Boolean common zero at N=4 excludes a certificate for each k>=2 in this exact class.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube: Actual Boolean/coarse/ordered-g cube and a strict finite weighted covering obstruction.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.BooleanLatt: Rational Boolean-lattice adjoints, commutator, and strict low-layer raising injectivity.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.BooleanCoef: Ordinary exponent-support aggregation and compatibility with genuine variable multiplication.
Aggregated coefficients vanish on supports larger than ordinary total degree.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.BooleanMult: Top-layer rigidity for the actual count multiplier, arbitrary rational parameter and signed functions.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.BooleanCoun: The genuine ordinary count polynomial maps to the actual count multiplier.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.BooleanAnni: Boolean-equation multiples have zero aggregated coefficient image, without asserting ordinary polynomial zero.
modules.AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.CountVariab: The actual variable and count actions commute on finite types for arbitrary rational parameters.
modules.Calibration.C1: Full-count calibration, prime support, unordered pairs including loops, and the exact independence threshold.
modules.Calibration.LowerBound: Universal ordinary-Q static-NS lower bound for the supplied full-count certificate, not an upper construction.
modules.Calibration.Growth: The required ordinary-Q static-NS degree is unbounded along even N, without asserting existence of certificates.
modules.Calibration.PCRestriction: Genuine ordinary-Q PC restriction preserves rules and line degree; the lower corollary retains an external hypothesis.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.horizonFamily_has_second_boolean_solution
declarations.source_header: theorem horizonFamily_has_second_boolean_solution (N M : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (hM : M ≤ (N / 2 - 3) ^ 2) : (∀ j, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (horizonFamily N M j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ (∀ j, eval (modelPoint N) (horizonFamily N M j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (modelPoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ modelPoint N ≠ primePoint N ℚ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.clause_eval

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.automatic_eval_zero

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.weighted_common_zero

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.support_card_le_exponent_sum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt_card

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_monomial

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_X_mul
declarations.source_header: theorem coefficients_X_mul {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) : coefficients (MvPolynomial.X i * p) = bitMul i (coefficients p)
declarations.informal_statement: Genuine ordinary variable multiplication maps to the actual finite-support bit action.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_count_mul
declarations.source_header: theorem coefficients_count_mul {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) : coefficients (((∑ i : σ, (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ ℚ)) - MvPolynomial.C m) * p) = countMul m (coefficients p)
declarations.informal_statement: The genuine ordinary count-polynomial multiple maps to the actual count multiplier.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.up_eq_sum
declarations.source_header: theorem up_eq_sum (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : up f s = ∑ i : σ, raiseAt i f s
declarations.informal_statement: The actual raising operator is the sum of coordinate raising actions.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.down_eq_sum
declarations.source_header: theorem down_eq_sum (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : down f s = ∑ i : σ, lowerAt i f s
declarations.informal_statement: The actual lowering operator is the sum of coordinate lowering actions.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.raiseAt_sum
declarations.source_header: theorem raiseAt_sum (i : σ) (F : σ → Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : raiseAt i (fun t => ∑ j : σ, F j t) s = ∑ j : σ, raiseAt i (F j) s
declarations.informal_statement: Coordinate raising commutes with finite rational function sums.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.lowerAt_sum
declarations.source_header: theorem lowerAt_sum (i : σ) (F : σ → Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : lowerAt i (fun t => ∑ j : σ, F j t) s = ∑ j : σ, lowerAt i (F j) s
declarations.informal_statement: Coordinate lowering commutes with finite rational function sums.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.coordinate_adjoint
declarations.source_header: theorem coordinate_adjoint (i : σ) (f h : Finset σ → ℚ) : (∑ s : Finset σ, raiseAt i f s * h s) = ∑ s : Finset σ, f s * lowerAt i h s
declarations.informal_statement: Coordinate raising and lowering are adjoint for the declared finite rational pairing.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.coordinate_commute
declarations.source_header: theorem coordinate_commute (i j : σ) (hij : i ≠ j) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : lowerAt i (raiseAt j f) s = raiseAt j (lowerAt i f) s
declarations.informal_statement: Distinct-coordinate lowering and raising commute.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.coordinate_diagonal
declarations.source_header: theorem coordinate_diagonal (i : σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : lowerAt i (raiseAt i f) s - raiseAt i (lowerAt i f) s = (if i ∈ s then (-1 : ℚ) else 1) * f s
declarations.informal_statement: The same-coordinate commutator is the declared signed diagonal action.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.adjoint
declarations.source_header: theorem adjoint (f h : Finset σ → ℚ) : (∑ s : Finset σ, up f s * h s) = ∑ s : Finset σ, f s * down h s
declarations.informal_statement: The actual total raising and lowering actions are adjoint.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.commutator
declarations.source_header: theorem commutator (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : down (up f) s - up (down f) s = ((Fintype.card σ : ℚ) - 2 * (s.card : ℚ)) * f s
declarations.informal_statement: The actual commutator acts by variable count minus twice support size.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.up_injective_below_middle
declarations.source_header: theorem up_injective_below_middle (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k < Fintype.card σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (hlayer : ∀ s : Finset σ, s.card ≠ k → f s = 0) (hup : ∀ s : Finset σ, up f s = 0) : f = 0
declarations.informal_statement: On a pure k layer with strict 2k<card sigma, a zero raising image forces the signed function to vanish.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.countMul
declarations.source_header: noncomputable def countMul {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ
declarations.informal_statement: The actual signed count action, with rational subtraction outside the finite sum.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.countMul_eq_diagonal_add_up
declarations.source_header: theorem countMul_eq_diagonal_add_up {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : countMul m f s = ((s.card : ℚ) - m) * f s + BooleanLattice.up f s
declarations.informal_statement: The actual count multiplier equals its signed diagonal action plus raising.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.top_layer_vanishes_of_countMul_degree_le
declarations.source_header: theorem top_layer_vanishes_of_countMul_degree_le {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k < Fintype.card σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (habove : ∀ s : Finset σ, k < s.card → f s = 0) (himage : ∀ s : Finset σ, k < s.card → countMul m f s = 0) : ∀ s : Finset σ, k ≤ s.card → f s = 0
declarations.informal_statement: With strict 2k<card sigma, function and count image zero above k force the function zero at and above k.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.bitMul_countMul
declarations.source_header: theorem bitMul_countMul {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (m : ℚ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) : bitMul i (countMul m f) = countMul m (bitMul i f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.primePoint_zero

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_excludes_common_zero
declarations.source_header: theorem certificate_excludes_common_zero {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N K) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N K) (B : R N K) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (x : Fin (N + 1) → K) (hF : ∀ j, eval x (F j) = 0) (hBool : ∀ i, eval x (booleanConstraint i) = 0) (hg : eval x (g N K) = 0) : False

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.eval_g_primePoint

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.goldbachCount_positive_iff

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.goldbachCount_le

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_goldbachCount_positive
declarations.source_header: theorem certificate_goldbachCount_positive {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N K) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N K) (B : R N K) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (hF : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N K) (F j) = 0) : 0 < goldbachCount N

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_implies_goldbach
declarations.source_header: theorem certificate_implies_goldbach {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N K) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N K) (B : R N K) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (hF : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N K) (F j) = 0) : ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p + q = N
declarations.informal_statement: A supplied certificate and prime-truth premises imply existence of the corresponding prime pair.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.eval_g_rat_nonzero_iff
declarations.source_header: theorem eval_g_rat_nonzero_iff (N : ℕ) : eval (primePoint N ℚ) (g N ℚ) ≠ 0 ↔ 0 < goldbachCount N

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_g_rat_positive

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bit_bertrand_product

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bit_coarse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.uniform_bertrand_countermodel

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.C1
declarations.source_header: theorem C1 (N m : ℕ) : (∃ x : ℕ → ℚ, D N m x ∧ g N x = 0) ↔ m ≤ pi N - r N
declarations.informal_statement: For natural m, a full D_m pseudo-model exists iff m<=pi(N)-r(N), including loop pairs.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.C1_primeCounting
declarations.source_header: theorem C1_primeCounting (N m : ℕ) : (∃ x : ℕ → ℚ, D N m x ∧ g N x = 0) ↔ m ≤ N.primeCounting - r N
declarations.informal_statement: The same exact D_m threshold is expressed with Mathlib primeCounting.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.r_le_pi
declarations.source_header: theorem r_le_pi (N : ℕ) : r N ≤ pi N
declarations.informal_statement: The unordered pair count is at most the prime count.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.no_pseudo_solution_at_full_count_iff
declarations.source_header: theorem no_pseudo_solution_at_full_count_iff (N : ℕ) : (¬ ∃ x : ℕ → ℚ, D N (pi N) x ∧ g N x = 0) ↔ 1 ≤ r N
declarations.informal_statement: Absence of a full-count pseudo-model is equivalent to a positive unordered representation count.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.r_positive_iff
declarations.source_header: theorem r_positive_iff (N : ℕ) : 1 ≤ r N ↔ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = N
declarations.informal_statement: Positive unordered representation count is equivalent to a prime pair summing to N.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.D_true_prime_indicator
declarations.source_header: theorem D_true_prime_indicator (N : ℕ) : D N (pi N) (fun p => if Nat.Prime p then 1 else 0)
declarations.informal_statement: The true prime indicator satisfies D at the full prime count.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.D_full_count_pins
declarations.source_header: theorem D_full_count_pins {N : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℚ} (hx : D N (pi N) x) : ∀ p ≤ N, x p = if Nat.Prime p then 1 else 0
declarations.informal_statement: Every full-count D model agrees with the prime indicator within the horizon.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.representatives_subset_maximumSupport_insert
declarations.source_header: theorem representatives_subset_maximumSupport_insert (N : ℕ) : pairRepresentatives N ⊆ insert (N / 2) (maximumSupport N)
declarations.informal_statement: All pair representatives lie in the maximum support plus the possible midpoint.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.pair_count_le_independence_plus_one
declarations.source_header: theorem pair_count_le_independence_plus_one (N : ℕ) : r N ≤ pi N - r N + 1
declarations.informal_statement: The representation count is at most the independence count plus one.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.independence_ge_half_prime_count
declarations.source_header: theorem independence_ge_half_prime_count (N : ℕ) : pi N / 2 ≤ pi N - r N
declarations.informal_statement: The independence count is at least half the prime count, with natural rounding.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.independence_unbounded_on_even
declarations.source_header: theorem independence_unbounded_on_even : ∀ d : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, Even N ∧ 4 ≤ N ∧ d ≤ pi N - r N
declarations.informal_statement: The independence count is unbounded along even N>=4.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.Dpi_standard_degree_unbounded_on_even
declarations.source_header: theorem Dpi_standard_degree_unbounded_on_even : ∀ d : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, Even N ∧ 4 ≤ N ∧ ∀ (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ), LowerBound.Restriction.DpiCertificate N A B U C → d < (A * LowerBound.Restriction.countConstraint N).totalDegree
declarations.informal_statement: Necessary count-summand degree for supplied full-count certificates is unbounded along even N>=4.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.falling_back

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.falling_front

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.inverse_count_fwdDiff

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.inverse_count_fwdDiff_ne_zero

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.inverse_count_cubeContrast

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.boolean_inverse_totalDegree_ge

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.totalDegree_substitution_le

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.totalDegree_eq_degLex_degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.totalDegree_mul_eq
